plugin.name: DNS
plugin.description: Manage DNS records and domains across Cloudflare, Route 53, Namecheap and other providers.

card.title: Domains
card.empty: No domains yet. Open DNS to add a login.

view.title: See DNS
view.description: Open the DNS tab and see zones, records, domains and health checks.

edit.title: Change DNS records
edit.description: Add, change and delete records, import zone files and refresh domains.

manage.title: Manage DNS logins
manage.description: Add provider logins, link records to hosts, watch domains and restore zone copies.

snapshot.title: Save a copy of a zone

description: Add your DNS and registrar logins to manage records and watch domains in one place. Keys are stored encrypted and never shown again.

fields.userName: Username (if different from the API user)

zones.emptyHint: Add a provider login in Logins to see its zones.

record.name: Name
record.ttlHint: How long resolvers keep the answer. 300 is 5 minutes.

account.name: Name
account.keep: Leave empty to keep the saved value
account.registrar: This provider is also a registrar, so its domains show up in Domains.
account.autoBackupHint: Save a copy before each change and when a zone changes outside Termix.
account.checkHealthHint: Run the health checks daily and alert on new problems.
account.deleteConfirm: Delete {{name}}? Its copies and links go with it. Nothing changes at the provider.
account.emptyHint: Add a Cloudflare, Route 53, Namecheap or other login to start.

domains.emptyHint: Registrar logins list their domains here. You can also watch any domain by name.

link.hostHint: The record follows the host's address. It updates when the host changes.
link.publicHint: Termix looks up its public address and keeps the record in sync, like dynamic DNS.
link.emptyHint: A link keeps a record pointed at a host or at this server's public address.
link.deleteConfirm: Remove the link for {{name}}? The record stays where it is.

copies.hint: Copies are saved before each change and once a day when a zone changed outside Termix.
copies.restoreConfirm: Restore this copy? {{count}} changes will be made at the provider. A copy of the current records is saved first.

files.exportHint: Download the records as a BIND zone file.
files.placeholder: Paste a BIND zone file here
files.replace: Remove records that are not in the file
files.replaceHint: Off, the import only adds and changes records.

health.empty: No checks have run for this zone yet.

delegation.error: The name servers could not be looked up.
delegation.none: The zone has no name servers on the internet. The domain may not point at this provider.
delegation.mismatch: The domain uses different name servers than the provider: {{found}}.
delegation.ok: The domain points at {{count}} name servers.

soa.differ: The name servers disagree on the zone version ({{count}} versions). A change may still be spreading.
soa.same: {{count}} name servers agree on the zone version.

dnssec.broken: DNSSEC is set up at the registrar but does not validate. Resolvers that check it will fail.

cname.conflict: {{name}} has a CNAME and other records. That is not allowed.
cname.apex: The zone root cannot be a CNAME.
cname.dangling: {{name}} points at {{target}}, which does not resolve.

spf.missing: The domain receives mail but has no SPF record.
spf.multiple: There is more than one SPF record. Mail servers will reject all of them.
spf.lookups: The SPF record makes {{count}} lookups. The limit is 10.

dmarc.none: DMARC is set to monitor only.

dkim.none: No DKIM keys were found in this zone.

mx.unresolved: The mail server {{host}} does not resolve.

mail.none: The domain has no mail records.

caa.ok: CAA records limit who can issue certificates.
caa.none: There are no CAA records. Any certificate authority can issue certificates.

widget.name: DNS
widget.description: Domains, expiring domains and failing records.
